    z=zipfile.ZipFile(p)

        x=z.read('xl/sharedStrings.xml').decode('utf8')
        ss=[re.sub('<[^>]+>','',s) for s in re.findall(r'<si>(.*?)</si>',x,re.S)]
    except KeyError:
        pass
    n=sorted(m for m in z.namelist() if m.startswith('xl/worksheets/sheet'))[0]

            col,attrs,inner=cm.groups()
            if 'inlineStr' in attrs:
                t=re.search(r'<t[^>]*>([^<]*)</t>',inner)
                val=t.group(1) if t else ''
            else:
                v=re.search(r'<v>([^<]*)</v>',inner)
                val=ss[int(v.group(1))] if (v and 't=""s""' in attrs) else (v.group(1) if v else '')
